distributors.name: PHD
distributors.method: Public JSON API (api.phdgames.com FilterProducts, no auth). Filtered to Pre-Orders Due + Trading Card Games.

distributors.name: GTS Distribution
distributors.method: Public CSV export: pc_combined_results.asp with downloadsearch=1 dumps all matching rows (name, sku, wholesale cust_price, SRP, release_date, order_due_date, per-warehouse stock, UPCs). Card Games facet key 04552AD14A72447B95ECFC368E1CB6BD. We filter order_due_date >= today.

distributors.name: MagX
distributors.method: Site URL unknown — could not find a distributor named MagX publicly. Ask the user for the URL.

distributors.name: ACD Distribution
distributors.method: Public Next.js/BigCommerce site. No anonymous JSON API; data (name, sku, upc, MSRP price, release_date, order_by_date, is_preorder) is embedded in each page's RSC HTML chunks. Preorders at /pre-order; TCG at /products/collectible-card-games/. Scrape = fetch pages with Mozilla UA + parse RSC. robots.txt allows product/category paths, disallows query-string URLs. Wholesale pricing requires login.

distributors.name: Southern Hobby Supply
distributors.method: Server-rendered PHP storefront, trivially parseable HTML tables. Logged out: name, SKU, release date, Order Due (preorder deadline). Prices hidden behind dealer login. CCG category /ccg-s/c13/ with ~25 game subcats, ?page=N pagination (40/page). Note: the site's preorder search URL (advanced_search_result.php) is disallowed by robots.txt — compliant path is crawling allowed category pages and reading each product's Order Due/pre-sell flag.

distributors.name: Universal Distribution
distributors.method: Public JSON API /api/v1/en/preorderproducts?limit=500 (grouped by category; TCG = 2000-series codes). Fields: productName, itemCode, UPC, manufacturer, releaseDate, customerOrderDue. Pricing requires dealer login (blank in report).
